note: Seed until the first training run: disruption rates per TAF risk level and lead from the June-July 2026 baseline backtest (reports/baseline-2026-10-03 on the history branch; 32 airports, 121,206 airport-hours vs BTS). That backtest defined a disrupted hour from departures only (>= 20% of departures 15+ min late with weather/NAS delay, or >= 5% weather cancellations), slightly looser than the model target. No hour-of-day climatology or analogs yet: usual = the airport rate over those two months.
